# Welcome to the GurrLab {-}

```{r fig.align='center', echo=FALSE, out.width='60%'}
knitr::include_graphics('GURR-Full_Color.png')
```

**Oregon State University · Hatfield Marine Science Center · Newport, Oregon**

---

This guide is your starting point for life in the GurrLab. It covers everything from lab culture and expectations to computing workflows, physical spaces, and role-specific onboarding paths.

Please note that this guide is **iterative** — input from colleagues and lab members is expected to strengthen the lab mission and streamline the onboarding process. Constructive critique is welcome. Reach out at [samuel.gurr@oregonstate.edu](mailto:samuel.gurr@oregonstate.edu).

---

## How to use this guide {-}

The guide is organized into six chapters:

| Chapter | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Getting Started](#welcome) | Accounts, contacts, meetings, day-one checklist |
| [Lab Philosophy](#philosophy) | Five pillars, diverse perspectives, critique culture |
| [Conduct & Expectations](#conduct) | Code of conduct, bidirectional expectations |
| [Computing](#computing) | Bash, Git/GitHub, R, HPC — tutorials and stack overview |
| [Lab Spaces & Collaborations](#lab-spaces) | Wet lab, equipment, Hatfield partnerships |
| [Role Guide](#guide) | Tailored onboarding paths by role |
